DANGER! This poisonous water seems to seep into your mechs components and cause serious issues. You should get out sooner than later.
DANGER! Essentia Obscura is rapidly turning your mech into pudding! Get out swiftly!
Welcome to your Mech Training Course. You can exit and enter your Mech with ^#FF1493;[E]^reset;.

The ^#orange;Tricorder^reset; can help you ^orange;equip^reset; and ^orange;refuel^reset; your mech. Fuel is important, so keep your mech topped up. Press the corresponding buttons on the tricorder after this mission to check it out. ^#Red;(If you see 'unauthorized user' restart the mission.)
Your mech can ^#FF1493;duck by pressing ^#FF1493;[DOWN]^reset;, or ^#FF1493;sprint with a ^#FF1493;[double-tap]^reset; in the direction you are walking.
Your mech will auto-crouch to fit into areas that it can pass, should the need arise. Such as at the top of this passage.

Your mech switches to a ground-movement configuration when in an environment with gravity, you can manually switch from ground-movement to flight-mode by ^#FF1493;double tapping the [UP] key^reset;, even on planets. Do so now to continue.

Please be aware of your mech's ^#bf2fe2;fuel^white; and ^#1d8e25;health^white; reserves, visualised respectively as the ^green;colored bars you can see above your vehicle^reset;. The ^#bf2fe2;fuel^white; will deplete over time and the ^#1d8e25;health^white; bar will deplete when the mech takes damage.
Zero gravity combat is a bit trickier than on flat ground. Accuracy is important, so you'll need to learn to lead your targets properly.
Now try throwing your mass around. Try to ^#FF1493;leap and ^#FF1493;stomp^reset; on the creatures ahead.
DANGER! Your mech's temperature control systems are failing! Evacuate immediately!
DANGER! Your mechs servos and components are rapidly freezing within the liquid nitrogen. That isn't a good thing. Evacuate soon or you will know regret.
Curious. This liquid appears to be restoring your mechs energy, rather than causing negative effects.
Remember, you can create a ^orange;Mech Repair tool^reset; at your ^orange;Tinkering Table^reset; and upgrade it to be more effective using your ^orange;Tricorder's upgrade menu^reset;.

Hostile entities also exist in zero-gravity environments. My cosmonautical records indicate that defeating them may result in obtaining an erchius battery, which your mech can absorb to replenish health and fuel.
Excellent. You have activated the Master Manipulator using this Crucible as a power source! Now you can really obliterate matter like a champ! Go!
Hmm. Do you see that door to your left, dear? There's no handle, but I think an explosion could blast it apart. Missiles are traditional, but any explosive should do.
A dead end? This isn't right...
Wait. Do you see that patch of floral ground there? The yellow ones? Try digging it up with your matter manipulator.
Excellent work, dear! I think the lack of shielding was creating that irregularity. I'm sure there're more to be found - keep an eye out for odd changes in the walls!
Watch out, the Floran of thiss region are famouss for being very ssavage. Even other floranss fear them.
Ixodoom husbandry iss a revered sskill amongsst the floran. Ixolingss raissed in thesse cavernss are brought to other planetss to grow.
Do you remember the Ixodoom we fought? It may even have come from here!
You have to wonder why ancient ruins are always filled with traps. Was it a major architectural movement amongst these people?
Reflective. I don't know about that, but it certainly makes for good exploring!
Now this looks ominous. It's as if the altar was set up to receive the sacrifice of some small, helpless critter...
What an impressive lithograph. No doubt this was carved by ancient hands, too... I wonder what those words mean?
I might go and have a look myself once it's safe to do so.
I think I'll come along as well, and I'm not taking no for an answer.
It looks much cruder than the other ones we've seen so far. And much larger, too.
Confident. I scaled statues like this all the time in my youth. Surely you can do so as well!
After all this work...I think there's some kind of final puzzle here. Have you discovered any clues while here, dear?
The front of the temple looks to be heavily guarded. Perhaps another route inside is available? We could avoid direct confrontation.
There must be something valuable here if it is actively patrolled. We should press on and see what secrets await.
This gate is locked. I wonder if there's a way to open it somewhere...
Okay...mayhem and death it is, then. Enjoy.
Such a beautiful place, flourishing under the desert! Such specialized ecosystems are always a joy to explore.
A wise choice! They won't see us coming now. Of course, it's also dark and creepy and likely full of nasty surprises. Use caution.
Now what is this we have here? Keep an eye out for secrets such as these. I expect you'll find many such hidden gems across the galaxy.
I don't know...this gives me a bad feeling.
Looks like you'll need someone helpful to hold down this button for you while you enter through the door.
More secret passages...this had better be worth it.
Ugh, look at all that slime. I don't envy you...
Oh, come on! Who builds something like this? I mean...really!?!
Let's just fill this hall with frikkin' ^red;LAVA^reset;. No big deal, guys. And then let's make the ground vanish at random! Team players, these.
Finally. I think we may be clear of evil, deadly traps. We may even walk out of here ^orange;RICH^reset;!
Our arrival appears to coincide with a rebel attack against the Miniknog. This is to both our advantage for the Protectorate to provide aid.
I am detecting numerous additional hostiles ahead, armed with what appear to be rather dangerous armaments.
Big Ape is a profoundly dangerous enemy, but is still vulnerable to weapons. Cut the head off the snake, and the Miniknog may crumble!
It is likely that you will require the spike sphere or some variant thereof to navigate this complex. I suggest equipping such at the available console.
The average sawblade's primary prey is cube-shaped boys of meat, but it is equally deadly to you.
The artifact ahead appears to be connected to the main power distribution network, but there is no readily evident means of activating it. Please experiment.
This receptacle appears perfectly suited for holding a ball-shaped object.
Exasperated. Not another one of THESE things! Well, at least you have your mech this time.
Is it just me, or does that wall look a bit ^orange;structurally unsound?^white;.
The path forks here. I'm detecting lifesigns on both ends, so take your pick.
A frog village. How quaint. The locals don't look friendly.
This hatch seems to lead into some ruins. Maybe you should check around town to see if the locals have rigged some controls up.
The door's locked, and the switch is on the inside of the bell tower. Is there a way to trigger, or failing that, destroy it?
Cultists! Just what are they doing here?
This frog looks pretty lonely, I think he'd like your company.
Well, that was quite the sticky situation. Are you all right?
This is an interesting one. Do you have a rocket launcher that can do guided rockets? I don't think you'll be able to reach the switch otherwise.
There's no way around it - the console holding the door shut is also connected to the hatch in front of you. I'm sorry, but to proceed you'll need to incinerate the dog.
Oh look, it's this again. To get at all those sweet, sweet pixels you'll need to consign this cat to a slow, painful, needless death.
Do you smell an ambush? Because all that darkness sure does.
Oh, I just figured out what else the cat console was linked to - the door you just came through. Good thing you weren't greedy and avoided being bitten in the ass by karma, eh?
Welcome, <insert subject name here>. You have chosen, or been chosen, to be the next benefactor of our highly advanced testing systems.
My name is Generic Omnipresent Voice, or GOV for short. While you are in the facility, I will be your guiding authority.
Do note that gravity anomaly fields are in effect on board this facility; while you will still fall, it will not hurt you.
Have a very safe and educational day.
Contained within this chest is a Tool For Spatial Transference Of Living Matter, or in layman's terms, a Relocator. Please retrieve it. It will be required for testing.
Please proceed to the button to meet a very special friend.
Friendship with Companion Punchy established and online. Friendship levels detected at 13.3 percent.
Teamwork is mandatory in the testing facility. Non-compliance will not be tolerated and you will be penalised for failure to display a sufficient teamwork exponent.
Success! Teamwork levels are now non-negligible. Please enjoy a moment in the Comfort Chamber with your Companion Punchy before proceeding.
Your Companion Punchy is more durable than appearances might otherwise suggest. It will bleed, burn, and die for you so that you don't have to.
Your Companion Punchy's loyalty exponent is currently 6. Should it drop to zero, sleep with one eye open.
These sensors are calibrated to detect only Companion Punchys, greed, faith, and hatred.
Contact with the Steele Tech(TM) energy lances will invariably result in vaporisation.
Happily, Companion Punchys are made of sugar, spice, everything nice, and chemical X, rendering them impervious to vaporisation.
Alas, this is the end of a beautiful friendship. Incinerate your Companion Punchy to continue. Only one of you may leave the facility alive.
Yes...I think it's about time for a very palatable reward...for a traitor like you. Enjoy it while you can. GOV out.
Yellow detectors detect Companion Punchys. Blue detectors detect... well, you.
Relax a while in our fully-equipped pleasure chamber.
Let's see how well you do under pressure.
Partners often switch sides in a dance.
It is imperative to note that due to the nature of the tests in this facility, you may very well end up stuck through very much fault of your own.
If this happens, please feel free to assume a fetal position, weep at your lack of forethought, and beam out of the facility.
Contained within the chest ahead is a Personal Spatial Transference Module, or in layman's terms, a Translocator. Please retrieve it. It will be required for testing.
Please note that from this point onwards, your performance will be evaluated. Use your translocator to navigate the tests in an expedient manner.
You will be graded on factors such as time, adroit use of the translocator, attitude, non-vapourisation, and other common test parameters.
Unlike other spatial transference devices, the relocator is pellet-based. Please make use of this advanced physics-compliant property to bounce away from this puzzle.
Being spatially relocated can be disorienting, but I have full faith you will overcome this obstacle. That, or be vapourised.
Thank you for participating in this small test! On behalf of all members of the facility, allow me to congratulate you on a job well done!
You may be pleased to know that you are in the upper quartile who managed to complete this section of the facility without partial or complete vapourisation.
Please depart via the radar in a calm and orderly fashion. Do remember to take your belongings with you.
Welcome to this testing facility. Please do note that in order to participate in the activities therein, you will need to possess a ranged weapon.
Please keep your limbs and personal effects on the platform at all times. The facility is not responsible for any death or loss resulting from your stupidity.
These ruins are ancient and appear to be sacred to the Floran for, I'd guess, religious reasons. Readings show they are also dark and ominous.
Bio readings show many lifesigns in these tunnels. Unfortunately, approximately 97% are hostile. I commend your valour.
What a feisty Floran! Reminds me of myself when I was younger, though I had fewer leaves. Hopefully we can trust this one
It is evident that these Floran are after something of grave cultural significance to them. They're worse than me on a bug hunt! Be careful, dear.
What a beautiful sight! By the by, did you remember to bring a grappling hook? There's still time to turn back and get one if you forgot.
These must be the cultists we were warned about. I'm sure there're more of them in the forest.
Did the cultists set this trap?
The forest is sending forth its own guardians to fight the cultists. I don't think they recognise that you're trying to help them, though.
Keep on your toes. I'm detecting a massive energy signature ahead.
They really have been busy corrupting the forest, haven't they?
To get through here, you're going to need a Distortion Sphere II or Armor Sphere. Otherwise, you'll have a tough time...
Press down to drop a bomb and blow this tile up!
Now you'll need some fancy timing. Use bombs to launch yourself upwards. Then do it again, and you're through.
This keep belongs to a Glitch known as the Baron. He is a retired hero, and by all accounts a little... Eccentric...He spends his retirement seeking strange and unusual artifacts for his collection.

He may have a few screws loose, dear, but he's not dangerous. He's' ^green;absolutely certain^reset; that this keep houses an ^red;ancient and terrible artifact^reset; and spends a fortune investigating.
There may be some truth to this, based on rumors I've heard over the last ninety years. Maybe there is something hidden in the ^green;foundation^reset;?
Well I'll be damned. The Baron was right. This must be the switch for the rumored 'secret' of the Keep. Be sure to get some scans of whatever you find. I'm really curious what you'll discover here!
Remember what the hunter said - if you die, you'll have to start all over again! Give the florans 15 minutes or so to reset the arena, and then you can make another attempt.
There're also some monsters left over from the last battle - mop them up before you start, okay?
Something about these cultists is setting off alarm bells. There is an eerie resemblance to something that I just can't place...
Rebel intelligence indicates that you'll need the Micro Spider Sphere or better to effect entry into the facility. We've provided a console for you to swap it in, if you forgot.
Before you do anything else, though, check in with the forward team leader and get further details of the task at hand.
There're the remains of earlier Miniknog facilities in the area. They ought to be mostly abandoned... mostly.
I suppose you could take this path if you wanted to avoid detection... although the old security systems are likely to have gone haywire.
You're not going to eat what you find in that ancient fridge, are you? Who knows how long that's been in there, and in so toxic an environment!
Ssayss the guy who drinkss Letheia Cola.
Wow, will you look at that! Just what warrants all these danger signs?
Who knows what kind of monsters the Miniknog produced on this toxic rock? I think you should leave it well alone.
And I think you sshould pussh the button! Then hunt the horrible monsster which appearss!
Remember, avoid the goons in black with visors. You won't be able to hurt them, and their bullets will rip right through your armour. Anyone else is fair game, though.
Whoa whoa whoa WHOA, soldier. Get away from the front door - you're not going to be able to force your way into THIS facility.
Head down and rendezvous with Tavish DeGroot; he should be somewhere nearby.
Great job getting in! Now the hard part begins. While you were out, Three-Eyes here started working his magic - how're you doing with those access codes?
I'll admit I was skeptical when every password was an anagram of 'banana', but they seem to have worked. Their firewall is pretty tough, though.
I can't remotely assume direct control of the facility's security systems, but I can give you permissions to operate them. Hope that helps.
Remember, you can't fight the goons in black directly. You'll have to find alternative ways to dispose of them - be creative.
This must be the main fabrication plant. Hmm, I'm picking up signals from a couple of goons ahead; this could be problematic.
There ought to be some way to dispose of them. One of the drawbacks of the prototype armour is that they can't run very fast in it.
Well, here we are. This must be where the research team lives and works, designing tools of cruel oppression, no doubt knowing what they're doing...
Hmm. If you are stuck, examining objects may yield valuable information on how to proceed, even if said objects appear familiar.
The entire facility appears to be surrounded by a jamming signal. I won't be able to get to you once you get any closer, so you'll be on your own.
Good luck, soldier. I get the feeling you'll need it. Letheia doesn't mess around when it comes to its security.
Scans indicate the corporate fleet consists of a battleship, a carrier, a tanker, and numerous other small vessels.
In order to board the battleship's main segment, you will need to activate IFF signals on the bridges of the carrier and tanker.
Due to the size of the fleet, your mech's initial energy reserves may be insufficient, especially if you sustain damage from their defenses.
Boarding ships and raiding their energy stores may very well be crucial to your success. Good luck.
Preliminary scans suggest that the sonic sphere will be essential here. If you have not already done so, please equip it at the nearby console.
I...remember reading about this. Before Earth's demise, a Protectorate division was dispatched here to investigate a distress signal. None of them returned.
The facility appears to under lockdown. If we can find survivors, however unlikely, that would be a great relief.
Sarcastic. Well, isn't this a lovely sight.
Hey, it's Letheia Cola! Anyone have any pixels?
...Do you even know what that sstuff doess to your inssidess, Fisshface?
This server appears to have important data marked out on it. If you find other servers marked out with lava lamps, I will be able to read their data.
'The organic samples arrived today from Anomalous Materials. We're very excited to work with them; the administrator has moved up the testing schedule.'
'These are nothing like we've ever seen before. Almost...no. If we succeed here, we're all getting promotions. This could be the discovery of the millennium.'

'We've cleared all nonessential vats for the project. Doubling times are far lower than expected; the biomass reproduces at an astounding rate. We need to find a way to effectively control this thing.'
'Even more interesting is that despite being only one sample, it appears to code for several different creatures...we'll need to look into this. It's a bit worrying.'
You have discovered a Steele Tech Mk-5 Mounted Plasma Gatling. This powerful weapon is incredibly devastating to anything caught in its line of fire.
However, it is stationary, and requires a recharge of about five seconds before it can be activated again. The blue ready light atop the chassis indicates charge status.
Please utilise this weapon judiciously, as I suspect you will need it soon. Several lifesigns are converging on your location.
The path forks here. Both will place you in peril. I commend your bravery in the face of vicious alien life and wish you good luck.
Stars above...how? Did they not realise what they were toying with here? This changes a lot.
In order to enter the vent, you will need to use your sonic sphere tech. My calculations suggest the middle of the hazard fence should do it.
There appears to be something about aliens and maintenance vents...
I once ssaw a holo-movie; it had an alien that could go anywhere it wanted via crawling through ventss. It also sstabbed thingss with itss tail.
We should watch that together sometime.
This Apex appears to have perished from malnutrition. The remains are positively emaciated.
Kluex protect this soul in the aether beyond. Starvation is a slow and terrible way to die.
I don't know how much more of this I can take. If I were still Grand Protector...if we could make Letheia pay for this somehow...
Warning! Containment lasers ahead are EXTREMELY DEADLY! ^orange;MAXIMUM SPEED^reset; is required in order to evade them!
According to the data, the chamber you are in appears to be an experimental setup dedicated to determining whether critters can indeed feel pain.
After 6,703 runs, the results are stated as 'Inconclusive. More funding required. Please petition for research grants next sol cycle.'
Now, I'm not usually one to judge, but...
...This sounds exactly like the kind of inane 'experiment' the Miniknog would devise for their own amusement.
They desserved everything that hass happened.
Might I take this moment to introduce everyone to the concept of cosmic karma?

'Vaughn, are you out of your mind? You talked to Alisa about your findings?! I told you clearly, no one outside Letheia is allowed to know what you're doing down there! You know what a gossip she is!'
'To make things worse, things are getting out of hand; it's spreading. How the hell did they get to the aquarium? And what's going on in the dorms?'
'Pete, the fish are looking pretty sickly. I think there's something in the water - filters probably got clogged again. I'll be down the maintenance hatch all day Tuesday, just FYI.'
'Hey, Backy - have you seen my cat? I know she likes to wander around, but I haven't seen her for a couple days now. Starting to get worried.'
'We've run the numbers; there's no doubt about it. All models for growth, lifespan and metabolism only work when applied across the entire population, rather than to individuals.'
'In some ways, they're like advanced hive insects, a single advanced superorganism. There seems to be something giving them purpose, but I can't determine what. Containment is vital.'
They couldn't have known, could they? No, they couldn't. But how could Letheia have acquired Ruin biomass before Earth's...incident?
Thiss place iss WRONG. Jusst looking at it makess me feel ill.
Concerned. Are you all right, Lady Bright? You appear to be shaking quite intensely.
No, no...I'm...I'm fine. I've come to terms with it. There are no survivors. And I had dared to hope.
I must beg your attention. I have located the coolant system for this facility's fusion reactor nearby to the west. There is a manual override to shut down the coolant pumps.
If you allow the reactor to overheat, there is a 100% chance it will explode, burning this moon and all Ruin biomass.
That appears to be our best chance, dear. Since there're no survivors, this place MUST be destroyed.
Hmph. Burning the planet? I say we should nuke it from orbit. That's the only way to be sure.
Please proceed into the room ahead; I will instruct you further there.
It would appear that the protectors tried to make a stand here. The door to the coolant systems is lacking power, but it can be restored through the console ahead.
I estimate it will take about 90 seconds for adequate power to be restored to the door. Additionally, I detect an immense number of lifesigns converging upon your position.
It knows what you intend, dear, and will do everything in its power to stop you.
Please prepare yourself before you activate the console. Judicious and effective use of the Steele Tech Plasma Gatlings will be essential to your survival.
Remember that this facility has no checkpoint; if your position is overrun, you will likely perish. I commend your bravery. Good luck.
This is button for the manual override; please depress it. I will delay the shutdown until you safely evacuate. There will be no timed escape sequence.
Erchius readings have reached 94 rad. You are in grave peril. My programming requires me to inform you that proceeding could prove dangerous. Use extreme caution.
Prolonged contact with the Erchius crystals seems to have denatured their very being! Curious. The creatures have lost themselves completely.
Erchius readings have reached 101 rad. I am also reading something massive below. ^red;WARNING: Continuing may to prove fatal. Are you sure you wish to proceed^reset;?
Conventional weapons will have nearly no effect on the Erchius crystal. You'll most likely need to devise another means of attack.
There is enough Erchius here to power the Outpost for quite a long time. ^orange;Great work, Agent^reset;! This will greatly help the Protectorate to reform.
I'm not sure where this teleporter has dropped us off. I am, however, detecting unknown signals up ahead somewhere. You should investigate, and find a way out.
Impossible. This ship is still functioning, albeit at vastly reduced capacity. It is unlikely that it could travel, but we could certainly learn something from its systems!
I believe this switch is linked to systems elsewhere in the facility. We should backtrack and see what has opened up once we've activated the console.
Readings are scattered here. These machines are likely interfering with the signal. I cannot detect lifesigns or robotic signatures accurately. Extreme caution is advised.

While its actual function is somewhat of a mystery, this unusual device appears capable of infusing weapons, armor and other gear with cosmic energies. I imagine with it, one could vastly improve gear quality.
We appear to be well and truly trapped. The way back has been blocked. I am also detecting an extremely powerful machine nearby, and it appears to be targetting your specific DNA.
This is of truly ancient design. The door appears sealed, but might open to sufficient explosive force.
It is highly likely that these ruins have not been accessed in thousands of years. I wonder what mysteries await?
Ahead I detect several meters of weakened material. You could try digging through and see how that goes.
The door here appears to be triggered remotely by something. I can only faintly read connections to some sort of sensor.
Something must trigger this small door. We should probably hunt around elsewhere and see what we can find.
This room was painstakingly hidden from casual view. There must be something above worth investigating.
It seems we have more to explore! I am detecting numerous hostile IFF readings below your position, so do take precautions.
There appears to be some sort of interesting technology suspended above that device. I recommend immediate investigation.
My database indicates this temple is suspended over a gas giant. Falling will result in your death. The triple jump, while not essential, will be exceedingly useful.
What will be required, though, is a grappling hook. Please head back and collect one if you do not have this item.
Oh? You have been given permission to tour the Sky Boulevard? I'm impressed! It's one of the most sacred sites off Avos!
Here, suspended with the power of avolite crystals, we can be the closest to the aether - and Kluex himself! Gosh, isn't he mighty?
Old habits die hard, don't they? He still thinks you're a tourist...
Did you say something, Madame Bright?
Blessed with powers from Kluex himself, Avos' greatest warriors are sent to the grand temples as guardians! I'm sure you'll find them strong and friendly!
But what's really exciting is that you're likely to meet not just one, but multiple stargazers! Oh, if only I could meet such important personages!
Wow! A stargazer's ship! I'd heard of them, but never seen one! You're being invited on board? I'm so jealous!
Oh! This is the grand observatory! From here, the Stargazers peer into the heavens and study the aether with great diligence!
We believe that by studying Kluex's great creations, we can learn more about the deity himself and the way he works!
After all, does the pot not reflect upon the potter's intentions and spirit?
Oh! This is a kinetic orb cannon! They're great artifacts left to us by Kluex himself!
We're not exactly sure what they're intended for...so we rigged them up to transport people instead!
Stand on the platform and make a small leap. A SMALL leap. It's like flying!
Oh my. Look at that trap ahead, dear. It seems particularly deadly.
Do you see that crystal battery over there? My hunch is that it powers the trap. Please smash it and see what happens.
These here are bounce pads. They're hardly as strong as a kinetic orb cannon, but will keep you aloft...if bouncy.
Please stop and listen! The inscriptions ahead are important! Let me translate:
'A test of the mind for the faithful. If the wrong levers are thrown when the console is activated, you will surely be destroyed.'
'In the next room, throw down two.'
'In this room, throw down three without three to make eight.'
'In this room, throw down four without four to make twelve.'
It looks like the temple ends here, yet this doesn't feel right...
Of course not! This is the test of faith: step out into the aether, friend, and Kluex himself will bear you across the sky!
Yes! Is it not written. 'Kluex himself will carry the faithful to the skies'? Step out over the edge without fear, friend!
I...I don't believe this. There shouldn't be any forces holding you up. And yet...
It is the force of faith itself! Kluex empowers the unshakeable!
And so your pilgrimage ends. Here, in the heavens, one is the closest to Kluex as one can be.
From here, one may view the aether, from here, one may view boundless eternity and realise one's smallness in Kluex's vast glory.
Please, let's take a moment to meditate on what you went through to get here, and what you have learned.
This hatch looks interesting; there ought to be a way to open it nearby. Search the cavern thoroughly.
The door's locked, but I see an open window you could get in by.
I have a bad feeling about this...
The gate switch's in the far guard tower - look, you can see it through the window. It's too small to climb in through, though...
Great job! Let's move on - the Commissar's home is bound to be crawling with guards.
Commissar Vonel's officers are dangerous foes, as you've probably experienced by now. Be careful.
Brr, it's cold! I hope you wrapped up well!
Commissar Vonel is a high-value target; his mountain facility and dacha are bound to be well-guarded. Eliminating him will deal a serious blow to the Miniknog's logistics operations.
We've arrived! This looks like a proper rustic backwater, all right.
Keeping peace in the galaxy is what the Protectorate is about, dear. Apprehending this criminal would certainly show we're up and about, if nothing else.
You might want to talk to the locals and stock up on supplies before heading out. We won't be able to return once we leave the fort.
The path forks here. The hillside is likely a straightforward path, but teeming with enemies. The mines are more treacherous, but you'll face less resistance.
What a treasure trove! We're rich! We're rich!
Going up the hill was hard enough...now we have to go DOWN? Give me a break!
Hank's men have dug into the hill with fortifications and traps. Hope you're confident enough in your combat abilities to bust their barricade!
Stop right there, criminal scum! Nobody breaks the law on my watch!
I'm really sorry about the AI. The programming team was having a rather...unique day when they were coding the humour module.
You've reached what appears to be the nerve center for this titanic monstrosity. This is it, now. Destroy the beast or we all perish!
My scans of the ruins suggest that you'll need the double jump or some iteration thereof to successfully traverse the ruins. Remember to have such equipped.
It may also be prudent to acquire some means of surviving great falls. Perhaps you'll find one if you search nearby?
Nostalgic. This tower blights the land, a bastion of villainy where cruel warlords hoard stolen wealth and train their armies. I encountered many in my youth.
Noble. Ascend the tower, O protector, and cast the vicious warlord from its top!
The warlord's minions appear to have taken prisoners; they may join you if you free them. You will need all the help you can get.
My scans suggest a 76% chance of this switch being important. You should disable it.
This door is locked and cannot be opened by any means. Find a way around.
You have fallen into a trap. You are in peril. Attempting to determine your current peril level...
Readings indicate your peril level is 5 morts. You are in less peril than would immediately appear. Please check the room thoroughly.
Oh look. More fire. Of course it hass to be fire! Why am I not ssurprissed?
Allow me to expresss my infinite gratitude that it iss you and not me who iss down there.
I simply do not understand such architecture. Who would build deadly traps in their home? What sort of twisted mind would live in such a place?
Amused. Don't judge, lad. Some people take great joy in turning a trip to the washroom into a matter of life and death!
I fail to see the humour in your words.
Appalled. This warlord has been holding such lovely damsels hostage! If only I were younger, I would be down there with you!
For villains and thugs, these people are certainly well-read.
Even enemies may have something to teach us, dear.
It is dark. You are likely to be eaten by a grue.
You have discovered an extremely well-hidden secret. Congratulations are in order.
The mod creator salutes your dedication to finding the secrets he has hidden in his creations. In finding and reaching this place, you've proven yourself worthy.
He also hopes you have as much fun playing Extra Dungeons as he did in making all these missions for you to enjoy! Please, stay awhile and rest before moving along!
Warning! You should not attempt to evade this trap unless you have the sonic sphere equipped!
We're on a rail, on a rail, on a rail...

My scans indicate there is some kind of ^orange;Welcome Beacon^reset; on this planet. I estimate a ^green;82% chance that it is worth investigating^reset;, and a 98% chance that you have nothing better to do.
^orange;Welcome^reset; to my Mobile Lab, traveller! Come on in and visit! I've got a big comfy couch and a medical bay if you have any nasty injuries to heal up!

If you've picked up this message, you must be near an ^orange;Ancient Gateway^reset; - please activate it to come and find me. ^green;You can power up the Gate with ^orange;Core Fragments^reset; and a ^orange;Tricorder^reset;.
In order to fix your ship you'll need to complete ^orange;several tasks^reset;. ^green;Speak to me^reset; to begin.
Your ship can't support any more crew members. Building Crew Beds can increase the crew size of your ship, or dismiss some staff through the terminal on your ship.

^#71f2f6;Press F to make use of the ^orange;Distortion Sphere Tech II^white; to transform in and out of a compressed form. If you're blocked, press ^orange;[Fire]^reset; to blow up obstacles with a bomb.

It appears you have obtained an upgrade to your ^cyan;Matter Manipulator^reset;. Using the ^orange;Shift + Secondary^reset; functionality of your ^green;Tricorder^reset;, you can replace your current device.

Various species expel their waste within this room. Except ^cyan;Kevin^reset;. Nobody has any clue where he goes to the bathroom, but he has never once used this facility other than as temporary storage for large carnivorous reptiles. ^cyan;Kevin^reset; maintains that this was necessary.

If you are an avid beekeeper, this is where you'll want to head to eschew yourself of excess Queens and Drones that do not meet your requirements. In exchange, you'll garner income and rare resources.

The ^orange;Tavern^reset; provides entertainment and legal intoxicants to off-the-clock staff or visitors to the Science Outpost. While not all of us partake, some alcohol provides useful boons when ingested. After the ^orange;Tavern^reset; you'll find nothing of interest to investigate.

Ah, the garbage area. What else needs to be said? One thing is for certain: you most assuredly have no interest in continuing further, past the next door. Nothing of use awaits. Just turn back and do not proceed. It's better that way.

So...you didn't listen. No worries. Whatever you do, do not speak with the X'i over there. He is not interesting or at all worth hanging out with. Not even a little. Ignore him. He doesn't have narcotics or illegal substances.

The ^orange;Instafreud^reset; reduces ^cyan;madness^reset;, helping even the most insane scientists come back from the worst possible mental traumas. It is the only guaranteed way to tame the voices in your head. You can also reduce Madness with crew, gear or consumables.
Nothing of interest lies below this point. You should definitely not proceed downward.
No good can come of going further. Turn back.

Contrary to the poster on the wall, there will soon be a reason to be upset If you keep going. You might end up in a conversation with ^cyan;Kevin^reset;. This is best avoided for the rest of your natural life if you have any intent of remaining sane. You were warned.

The ^orange;Market^reset; provides a wealth of unique finds for sale to researchers and visitors alike, regardless of their affiliation. Some shopkeeps will provide quests from time to time, as well. I advise perusing every store : you never know what you'll find!

^cyan;Kevin^reset; insists he was given this award for the best-selling album of all time among Mantizi culture :^yellow;'Holy Crap, Look At The Size of that Sandwich!'^reset;. No proof has ever been provided. It is best to assume this is bullshit.

Yes, we have a ^orange;Starbucks^reset;. It's been here as long as anyone remembers: We cannot find the agreement we signed, nor have Starbucks been able to do so, that led to it being set up here. We have simply learned to accept it. ^cyan;Kevin^reset; without caffeine is not a thing you want to see.

^orange;Troughs^reset; provide a place to store food for your farm animals. When one of them becomes hungry, they will seek food there. With enough food they'll become happy, which increases their chance to produce offspring if a viable mate is nearby!

 The focus is on getting you to use the ^orange;Research System^reset; first and foremost, so be sure to keep your Tricorder handy.

Select a research by clicking one of the icons on the grid.
You can navigate the grid by dragging with the left mouse button.

- The topmost button at the right corner closes the research interface.

- The second button opens a list of research trees to pick from.

- The third button opens a list of non-hidden research options. Click a research on the displayed to center the view on it. Click again to hide the list.

- The fourth button will center the view on the middle of the tree, or the currently selected research.

- The last button toggles ^orange;low quality mode^reset;. This makes the GUI jump to a position instead of panning to it, or the center button. In addition, dragging/navigating on the the main screen will update only after you release the mouse button. It is best to use the search list with this mode enabled.

^orange;Tier 5.5^reset;

The searing hot petals of the Aenema plant are packed with useful Caliginous Gas just waiting to be extracted. Now that you can cultivate your own Aenema, you will have easy access to that resource.

^orange;Tier 1^reset;

You've learned to raise bees in an apiary to provide you with useful resources. Make an ^cyan;Apiary Crafting Station^reset; at your ^orange;Machining Table^reset; to get started.

Raising bees is pretty complex. If you're not sure how, buy a guide from the Bee Refuge in the Science Outpost, accessible once you leave your starter planet.

As a simple starter tip, you need a microscope-identified queen, a matching microscope-identified drone, one or more frames, and some flowers planted nearby for production to start.

^orange;Tier 2^reset;

You can make bigger bee apiaries and more useful Frames to supplement their production.

^orange;Tier 4^reset;

You can make even more powerful Frames that drastically improve your bees' efficiency.

^orange;Tier 5^reset;

You can make advanced Frames that drastically improve your hives.

^orange;Tier 6^reset;

You have achieved a truly enviable master's degree. You have managed to make your hives produce efficiently.

^orange;Tier 3.5^reset;

You've learned to grow the gross-but-useful Blister Pods. They're bioluminescent, and can be used in making weapons and armor, as well as lights for decorating your base.

^orange;Tier 3^reset;

The universe is a hostile place, with countless monsters and enemies out for your blood and few allies to stand alongside. Your research levels the playing field, fortifying your health and increasing your defenses to shield you from harm.

^orange;Tier 4^reset;

Your studies have borne fruit, granting you the ability to grow stronger varieties of fortifying plants, as well as a curious tentacled plant that reflects damage back at those who would seek to harm you.

^orange;Tier 5^reset;

Through much experimentation, you're gradually becoming a force to be reckoned with. Your plants can strengthen you to inhuman levels, sap your enemies' life and increase the damage you deal out.

^orange;Tier 6^reset;

An unstoppable juggernaut, you now hunt those who used to prey upon you, draining their vitality even as you slay them with your organic weapons. The universe is yours to take now, and your genetic weaponry is unparalelled.

^orange;Tier 2^reset;

You've mastered all the plants the Protectorate Academy taught you about, allowing you to artificially create many more plants, including the all-important ^yellow;Cotton^reset;.

You're ready to start branching into making various medicinal plants that don't provide satiation, but don't spoil and provide useful buffs like environmental resistance, healing, increased stats, or even act as weapons!

You'll need ^orange;genes^reset; from this point on - found by processing seeds, saplings and some produce in the ^cyan;Sprouting Table^reset; or its upgrades. Some plants produce more seeds than others: flowers unsuited for dye-making are a good early source of seeds.
